- Metro wagon: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/metro-wagon-9061849750014cd6ab5591b3484326b8 — downloadable CC BY, 33.7k triangles, simplified interior.

- Metro railcar: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/subway-railcar-ezh-3-4ac2b9e0580b4536a5e503627b9c1b98 — downloadable CC BY, 148k triangles, several paintjobs.

- Historical train wagon: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/train-wagon-b82896c35202456599d65190770789ea — CC BY, 29k triangles, 4K textures, NoAI restrictions; not suitable for generative AI inputs.

- Submarine with cutaway interior: https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/submarine-with-interior-70f0532170b44593a5afa88ffc7c0c1e — CC BY, 162k triangles, **half-hull educational model, not a finished playable submarine**.
